The public interest requires that a portion of Oloran avenue be closed up and abandoned, as hereinafter described; be it Resolved, That it is the intention of the Board of Supervisors to close.

This Board did declare that the damages, costs and expenses of closing said street are nominal, and no assessment district is necessary to be formed for the purpose of paying the damages, costs and expenses thereof…
